RESUBMISSION 1: WITH MIRO AND GITHUB LINKS DOUBLE-CHECKED AND ACCESSIBLE FOR PUBLIC REVIEW

RESUBMISSION 2: What we called ‘Website-landing page’ will be part of our DLT360 Website, but will appear as separate website-section. This Corporate DAO project has the job to identify different possible DAO use-cases for the corporate world. A real user-oriented website will then need to be established for each of these identified applications (together with dAPP and the entire required technology stack), once each of these potential projects enter MVP phase. THE CORPORATE DAO WEBSITE (section of the DLT360 We site) EXPLAINS AND PROMOTES THE USE-CASES AND RESULTS OF THIS CONCEPT PHASE - promoting and explaining what this is all about and integrating Pitch-Deck and Pitch Video. Forget the term ‘landing page’. We will produce this website-section in a way that is most helpful for getting to the MVP phase of at least one of the identified Corporate DAO applications and in a way that is most informative for future customers and partners. PLEASE NOTE: THE CONCEPT/WIRE-FRAMING/Prototyping of this is Website-section is PART OF MILESTONE 3.
